encoder_budget: d256 / ~6L frozen P1 trunk (+ frozen canonical keys; glue-only train)
primary_goal: Demonstrate a causal two-hop pointer-chase mechanism in fp space (re-anchor query), not general reasoning or open-domain QA.

success_bands.mechanism_ok: EM 0.50+ on held-out toy 2-hop chains WITH beats-one-hop (+0.20 vs max_hops=1), tape causal (shuffle/empty/delete-middle), and language CE gate intact.
success_bands.mechanism_strong: EM 0.60–0.70 on toy eval is a win for mechanism at this scale — still NOT a claim that the model learned to reason.
success_bands.partial: Causal middle-edge delete + beats max_hops=1, but unseen_pair or stop_selectivity weak — record FP_COMPOSE_PARTIAL, do not upgrade headline.

explicitly_not_claimed: Latent multi-hop inside transformer forward (210–212 thesis)
Composition on wiki stream tape without a dedicated e2e stage (255→256→257 product wiring)
Strong generalization beyond held-out relation-pair combinations at toy entity scale
culture_note: Closed branches win when verdict JSON states scope upfront. A partial mechanism pass is publishable engineering; overstating to reasoning is not.
